serverSetting.title: Server connection
serverSetting.notSet: Not connected — sample data will be shown
serverSetting.help: Enter the address of the computer running the backend. If it cannot connect, the app shows sample data rather than failing.
serverSetting.okMock: ✅ Connected, but sample data will still show (no API keys set).
serverSetting.unreachable: ❌ Could not reach the server. Check the address, that it is running, and the firewall.

gps.denied: Location permission denied. Allow it in Settings, or pick your district below.
gps.disabled: Location is switched off on your phone. Turn it on, or pick a district.
gps.timeout: Could not get a fix. Move into the open and retry, or pick a district.
gps.error: Could not get your location. Pick a district.

login.title: Your account
login.why: Sign in with your mobile number to track your crops and keep your farm details. Weather, irrigation and mandi prices work without signing in.
login.sendFailed: Could not send OTP. Check the server connection.
login.privacy: Your number is used only to identify your farm. It is never sold.

twin.loginPrompt: Sign in to track your crops
twin.loginWhy: Track a crop from sowing to harvest. Once it is recorded, advice follows your crop’s actual stage.
twin.firstCycleWhy: Just tell us which crop, where, and when you planted it. Advice follows from there.
twin.firstPlotHelp: Your first plot will be created automatically.
twin.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the server connection.
twin.defaultsNote: Soil: {{soil}} · Water: {{method}} — taken from your earlier choices; you can change it later.
